name: markdown-review
description: Markdown reader and reviewer with inline commenting, AI agent tools, and one-click Copilot integration

commands.title: Markdown Review: Open Preview with Comments
Markdown Review: Open Word Document Preview

languageModelTools.name: markdownReview_list_comments
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all review comments on a markdown document. Returns each comment's ID, text, status (resolved/unresolved), block type, surrounding context, reply count, and role. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comments are on, especially when multiple markdown files are open. Without filePath, the tool uses the currently active editor tab which may not be the intended file.

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the markdown file. If omitted, uses the currently active markdown document.

languageModelTools.name: markdownReview_read_comment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads a specific review comment by ID, including its full text, all replies, and the surrounding markdown context (5 lines before and after the anchored block). IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comment is on. Without filePath, the tool may look in the wrong file and return 'not found'.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to read (e.g., 'c1773348143590')

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the markdown file.

languageModelTools.name: markdownReview_reply_to_comment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replies to an existing review comment. The reply is added with role 'agent'. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comment is on. Without filePath, the tool may fail to find the comment if a different file is active in the editor.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to reply to

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the markdown file.

languageModelTools.name: markdownReview_resolve_comment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Marks a review comment as resolved. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comment is on. Without filePath, the tool may fail to find the comment if a different file is active in the editor.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to resolve

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the markdown file.

languageModelTools.name: markdownReview_delete_comment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes a review comment and removes its anchor from the markdown file. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comment is on. Without filePath, the tool may fail to find the comment if a different file is active.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to delete

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the markdown file.

languageModelTools.name: markdownReview_scroll_to_comment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Scrolls the markdown review preview to show the block associated with a specific comment. Also reveals the source line in the editor. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comment is on.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to scroll to

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the markdown file.

languageModelTools.name: markdownReview_capture_screenshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Captures the rendered markdown review preview as a self-contained HTML file. Saves to .review-screenshot.html next to the markdown file. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file to capture.

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the markdown file.
